idea-plugin.name: All Focus Highlighter
idea-plugin.description:
Makes it obvious which tool window or editor split currently has keyboard focus by drawing a colored border around it.
  • Highlights the active tool window (Project, Logcat, Build, etc.)
  • Highlights the focused editor split when working with multiple open editors
  • Configurable color, border thickness, and minimum highlighted size via Tools → Focus Highlighter Settings… or Settings → Tools → All Focus Highlighter

Source: github.com/landenlabs/as-plugin-focus
